headline: GPT-6 Astra cracks WWI German radio cipher, researchers reveal
summary: A new AI model, GPT-6 Astra, has successfully deciphered a complex German radio cipher from World War I, showcasing advanced cryptographic capabilities.
details: Researchers have developed a new AI model, dubbed GPT-6 Astra, capable of deciphering historical ciphers.
The model was successfully used to crack a German radio cipher dating back to World War I.
This breakthrough demonstrates the potential of advanced AI in cryptanalysis and historical research.
caption:
AI model GPT-6 Astra cracks a WWI German radio cipher.

Researchers have developed a new AI model, dubbed GPT-6 Astra, capable of deciphering historical ciphers.

The model was successfully used to crack a German radio cipher dating back to World War I.

This breakthrough demonstrates the potential of advanced AI in cryptanalysis and historical research.
